enum T_GLC_CTRL_POINT_OPCODE

Glucose Record Access Control Point OpCodes.

Values:

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_RESERVED

Reserved for Future Use.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_REPORT_RECS

Report stored records.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_DELETE_RECS

Delete stored records.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_ABORT_OPERATION

Abort operation.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_REPORT_NBR_OF_RECS

Report number of stored records.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_NBR_OF_RECS_RESP

Number of stored records response.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPCODE_RESP_CODE

Response Code.

enum T_GLC_CTRL_POINT_OPERATOR

Glucose Record Access Control Point Operator.

Values:

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_NULL

NULL.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_ALL_RECS

All records: No Operand used.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_LT_EQ

Less than or equal to: Operand contains at least a maximum value.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_GT_EQ

Greater than or equal to: Operand contains at least a minimum value.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_RANGE

Within range of (inclusive): Operand contains at least a minimum value, maximum value pair.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_FIRST

First record: No Operand used.

enumerator GLC_RACP_OPERATOR_LAST

Last record: No Operand used.

enum T_GLC_CTRL_POINT_FILTER_TYPE

Filter Type values.

Values:

enumerator GLC_RACP_FILTER_TYPE_RESERVED

enumerator GLC_RACP_FILTER_TYPE_SEQ_NBR

Sequence Number.

enumerator GLC_RACP_FILTER_TYPE_TIME

User Facing Time (Base Time + Offset Time).
